name: Glosdalen
tagline: Vocabulary lookup with direct Anki card creation
blurb: Glosdalen is a language and knowledge lookup app that integrates seamlessly with AnkiDroid for efficient language learning.
description:
Glosdalen is a language and knowledge lookup app that integrates seamlessly with AnkiDroid for efficient language learning.

Key Features:
• High-quality language lookup
• Support for 30+ languages including German, Swedish, English, French, Spanish, Italian, and more
• Direct Anki card creation with one tap

Requirements:
• AnkiDroid app installed for card creation
• DeepL or Copilot API access

Perfect for any language learning combination you need!
